title: 16 Hour Lounge Game Transformation with Fable 5.2
author: SignificanceFun550
selftext:
I've spent several months building an ios app with Coded/Claude which I [previously posted on](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1xohrvu/dominoes_personalities_carnage/).  Over the weekend I decided to burn my remaining week's resources transforming it into a Three.js web app  with Fable 5.2 in around 16 hours.  

Using the ios app as source material, Fable carved the puppets you're looking at in Blender and built a variety of lovely environments using Three.js.  It supports mobile, multiplayer and was QAed against Firefox/Chrome/Safari in Mac, Windows, ios, android.  

I had a little too much fun: 

The velvet lounge supports leaving the table, interacting with patrons (voices powered by eleven labs) ordering drinks

I added Bar games (8-ball, darts) with open window views of multiple skylines (Dallas, San Francisco, Pyongyang, Shenzen, Hong Kong, Reno, Niagara Falls)

The 1:1 tables got a variety of colorful stages that include a glass view submarine, a cliff funicular, Dr Bob's lab

I also ported one of my domino death games: Glass Bridge where those that fail to score a five plummet to their gibbed doom.  If you can blank the table, watch all 4 opponents plummet simultaneously.

I've begun importing some of the blender models back into the iOS version to play with more Godot 3d libraries there.  The iOS app seems reasonably well received; please check out the totally free web version here: [https://www.mugginsapp.com/table/](https://www.mugginsapp.com/table/)
